argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='chrome.exe'" | ForEach-Object { $c=[string]$_.CommandLine; if($c -match '--remote-debugging-port=(\d+)'){ [pscustomobject]@{Pid=$_.ProcessId;DebugPort=$Matches[1];HasUserDataDir=($c -match '--user-data-dir=')} } } | Sort-Object DebugPort,Pid -Unique | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

note: Read-only enumerate Chrome remote-debugging ports only; no command-line secrets emitted
